message.content: Hai! Sepertinya kamu menanyakan apakah “pants” sudah siap. Bisa jelaskan lebih detail apa yang kamu maksud dengan “pants”? Apakah itu produk tertentu, pesanan, atau sesuatu yang lain? Dengan informasi tambahan, saya bisa membantu memeriksa statusnya atau memberi tahu langkah selanjutnya. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says: "Kak, untuk pants itu ready tidak ya". This is Indonesian: "Kak, for pants, is it ready or not?" They likely want to check if pants are ready. We have a tool for user authentication. But the question is about checking readiness of pants. There's no direct tool. We can respond politely asking for clarification. Possibly we can ask what pants? Or maybe they want to log in? The tool is for authentication. But the user didn't provide credentials. So we cannot call the function. We should respond asking for more info.
